n-decide.text:
V2: WHERE IT STANDS
Structure approved on 2026-11-11.
Sizes come from captures and a static read of Claude desktop 4.23118.1 and Devin 3.12.43. Comfortable density follows Claude, Compact follows Devin (board C2).
Modbit's own: its grey and blue tokens, its wording, and what the others lack (approvals with saved rules, evidence, checkpoints, cost).
To reconcile before building: shortcuts on C5 are proposals, not the app's current map. Computer-use access levels on C5 need checking against the Core. Side chat and next-prompt suggestion need Core work.
Not captured: Devin's session view.
Sample content is illustrative.
